title: Among all molecules labeled as carcinogenic that contain at least one tripl
question: Among all molecules labeled as carcinogenic that contain at least one triple bond, determine how many distinct chemical elements appear in their atomic composition. Exclude any molecule that does not have a triple bond or is not marked carcinogenic.

prediction.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_003") FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_010" INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_005" WHERE T2."XCL_011" = '+' AND T3."XCL_006" = '#'

FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
JOIN bond b ON a.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
  AND b.XCL_006 = 'Triple'
